newsitem.title: FRANCE: Legris rises on brokers ratings changes.
newsitem.headline: Legris rises on brokers ratings changes.

text.p: Shares in Legris Industrie were sharply higher on Wednesday after several brokers raised their rating on the company, traders said.
At 1520 GMT, the stock was up 6.15 percent at 193.20 francs on volume of about 34,000, while the CAC-40 index was up 0.2 percent.
Brokerage Leven changed its rating from hold to buy because of the solid performance of its core businesses in a difficult economic context and the slight rise in profits expected for the 1996 year.
Du Bouzet changed its rating from lighten to reinforce, saying the outlook was clearer for the company.
